products.body_html:
Enjoy your favorite drink with a proper Old Fashioned Glass.

We partnered with VYCE to elevate your glassware collection.  Merrill Logo is laser etched. The glass is ideal for muddling ingredients, stirring, and accommodating a large ice cube or two.  For whiskey use only.

VYCE glasses are expertly crafted from premium lead-free crystal. The glass undergoes a specialized process to ensure it is balanced, lightweight, and exceptionally durable.

products.title: MERRILL GOLF SHOOTOUT
products.body_html:
Single Entry Ticket (1 Person)

Join us for the first Merrill Golf Shootout at the Ranch in Laguna Beach!

9-hole tournament at one of Southern California's most scenic courses, followed by food and drinks at the Resort Fit Pits.

Sunday November 10th

The Ranch Laguna Beach

31106 Coast Hwy

Laguna Beach, CA

3:00 PM Start

5:30 PM Awards, Food, & Drinks

*All Ticket Sales are Final.  Please email your full name and handicap to info@merrillgolf.com after purchase.  Details and rules of play will be sent after spots are filled.  If weather causes a cancellation, your funds will be automatically refunded.

Sponsors: Bird Darts, VYCE Drinkware
